meta.title: JSON Formatter - S-Jiffy
meta.description: Format, validate, and minify JSON instantly. Developer-grade tool with syntax checking.
clickValidateMsg: Click Validate to check the CSV for issues.
steps_json-formatter_1Desc: Paste minified or messy JSON into the input area. The formatter accepts any valid JSON — arrays, objects, deeply nested structures. Your data stays in your browser.
steps_json-formatter_2Desc: Click Format to pretty-print with indentation, or Validate to check for syntax errors. Error messages point to the exact line and character of any issues.
steps_json-formatter_3Desc: Click Copy to grab the formatted JSON to your clipboard. Ready to paste into your code editor, API client, or documentation with proper indentation.
desc: Format, validate, and minify JSON instantly. Developer-grade tool with syntax checking.
